Contrast checks · selected palette

Calculated WCAG contrast for the actual solid colour pairs below. Normal text target ≥ 4.5:1. This is a focused colour check, not a full accessibility certification.

Vibrant, not visually exhausting

Chroma lives in actions, selected states and accents. Reading surfaces stay quieter so people and their profiles remain the focus.

Dark mode is its own design

Brighter brand tones sit on tinted dark surfaces. Button labels switch to a dark ink where that gives stronger contrast. It is not a colour inversion.

Design principles, not magic psychology

Hue relationships, saturation hierarchy and measured contrast guide these choices. No colour scientifically guarantees attraction, trust or dating-app success. Test with your audience.

Preview interactions are local: switch screens, open a profile card, or select a plan. No accounts, messages or payments are created. No external dependencies or network requests.
